name: Shareholding Balance 1
definition: Provides detailed shareholding balance information for an account.

Quantity.name: Quantity
Quantity.definition: Number of shares of this type of shareholding or with this date of shareholding held by the account owner.

InitialDateOfShareholding.name: Initial Date Of Shareholding
InitialDateOfShareholding.definition: Date as from when the shares have been held by the shareholder on its account.

ThirdParty.name: Third Party
ThirdParty.definition: Third party who is authorised to take specific actions on behalf of the shareholder.

SupplementaryData.name: Supplementary Data
SupplementaryData.definition: Additional information that can not be captured in the structured fields and/or any other specific block.
